_about: The WWII pack's personnel pictures (tools/look/make_ww2_portraits.py): per character, the Wikimedia Commons file its picture is cut from - the file's page, its original's address and SHA-1 as Commons publishes them, its licence and author - and the crop, [cx, cy, side]: the square's centre as fractions of the picture's width and height, its side as a fraction of the height. Every crop keeps clear of the swastika and the Iron Cross: no picture shows either (TeeJ, 2026-09-30: an eagle may show, the swastika never). A character with `generic` gets the drawn stand-in, for the reason given.
